title: Week 2 — 41 miles
description: Feet hurt, Tuesday got cut short, and the mileage still got done.
body:
Planned: 41 miles. Actual: 41.

Feet hurt and I couldn’t finish Tuesday’s run. I made the mileage up through the rest of the week.
